entities.name: NodQ-like bifunctional enzyme
observations: 650-aa query has 78.4% identity and 96.9% coverage to reviewed Rhizobium sp. NodQ P72339; best hit E-value 0.
Pfam matches support a NodQ architecture: N-terminal GTPase-related region and C-terminal APS kinase domain.
Reviewed NodQ annotations indicate sulfate adenylyltransferase and adenylylsulfate kinase activities; activated sulfate is proposed to support Nod-factor sulfation.

entities.name: Sulfate assimilation
observations: Sulfate assimilation is a GO biological-process annotation in high-identity reviewed NodQ homologs; annotation evidence is inferred (ECO:0000501), not a direct experiment on the query sequence.

entities.name: Nod-factor sulfation
observations: NodQ homologs are proposed to provide activated sulfate for transfer to Nod factor; the referenced annotation states this proposal is by similarity.
